card.name: Words just before a predictable next term
card.fires_on: Short words in drug-label sentences where one specific next word is very likely, such as 'the' before 'excipients' or 'test' before 'dose'.

modes.label: the before excipients
modes.description: The word 'the' in contraindication sentences about hypersensitivity to the drug or any of the excipients.
modes.example: 4.3 Hypersensitivity VABYSMO is contraindicated in patients with known hypersensitivity to faricimab or any of<< the>> excipients in VABYSMO.

modes.label: test before dose
modes.description: The word 'test' in epidural anesthesia advice about giving a test dose of a local anesthetic.
modes.example: it is recommended that a<< test>> dose of lidocaine hydrochloride

modes.label: Other modifiers
modes.description: A modifier or partial term before a fixed medical word, such as cross before resistance or a number before dose level.
modes.example: Some maribavir pUL97 resistance-associated substitutions confer<< cross>>-resistance to ganciclovir
